title: VR-Apparatus: A Lean 4 Formalisation of the Two-Apparatus Two-Mode Methodology of the VR Cycle (v1.0.0)
description:
Lean 4 formalisation of VR-Apparatus, the seventh work in the VR Cycle. Meta-work formalising the methodological apparatus used implicitly through the prior six works (VR, VR-Numbers, VR-Sets, VR-Forms, VR-Audit, VR-Sets-ZFA).

The apparatus distinguishes two methodological modes:
- Predicate-wrapping (PredicateOperationality): objects identified by classical type membership with operational predicates. Example: IsComputableReal on Real.
- Reference semantics (ReferenceOperationality): objects identified by position in reference graph. Example: OSetZFA via cobisimulation quotient.

Two transit modes formalised:
- Mode A: operations preserving operational predicates lift to operational subtypes. Closure theorem proved by rfl.
- Mode B: classical operations with Factorisable witness yield operational results. Captures operand-not-operation principle.

Layered architecture (five tiers):
1. Apparatus instances (PredicateOperationality, ReferenceOperationality).
2. Domain structures (HasSeparabilityStructure).
3. Morphism levels (Mode A, InterApparatusMorphism, Mode B).
4. Compositional algebra (within tracks).
5. Cross-instance recognition (VR-Forms transit as Mode B).

Technical facts:
- 68 public objects across 12 implementation files, ~3430 lines of Lean
- 40 axiom-free objects (59%)
- New sub-ceiling tier [Quot.sound] discovered (7 objects)
- No sorry, no admit, no axioms beyond mathlib standard ceiling
- Lean 4.29.1 + mathlib4 v4.29.1
- Git tag: v1.7-vr-apparatus-1.0.0

Twelve methodological findings catalogued: two parallel tracks (predicate, reference), layered structure, productive triviality pattern, spectrum of witnesses, self-witnessing, two-level Factorisable, lens applicability depends on natural structure, axiom asymmetry between tracks, generic Register abstraction unnecessary, three-way identity nature contrast.

Three honest scope limitations: no ReferenceOperationality for Cauchy sequences (no natural membership), no DirectionalMorphism (Mode B captures asymmetry), no generic Register structure (Lean typeclass system already provides it implicitly).

Seventh work in the VR Lean cycle. Developed using Claude Opus 4.7 (architectural review) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Lean implementation), Variant A.
